definitions.explanation: To come after in sequence or rank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{継|つ}ぐ。
⟦{一位|いちい}→一位：08926_ichii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{次|つ}ぐ。
⟦{家業|かぎょう}→家業：12353_kagyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{継|つ}ぐ。
examples.english: To take over the family business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{次|つ}ぐ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧。
examples.english: The second largest city after Tokyo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{相|あい}{次|つ}いだ→相次ぐ：14869_aitsugu⟧。
⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{継|つ}ぐ。
⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{次|つ}ぐ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧。
⟦{血筋|ちすじ}→血筋：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{継|つ}ぐ。

examples.english: To inherit the skills of one's predecessor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{次|つ}いで⟦{韓国|かんこく}→韓国：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: After Japan, South Korea has the most.

notes:
つぐ has different meanings depending on the kanji used.

KANJI DISTINCTION:
- {次|つ}ぐ: to come next, to follow in rank
- {継|つ}ぐ: to inherit, to succeed (position/business)

COMMON PATTERNS WITH {次|つ}ぐ:
- Xに{次|つ}ぐ: second to X, after X
- {相|あい}{次|つ}ぐ: to happen one after another

COMMON PATTERNS WITH {継|つ}ぐ:
- {家業|かぎょう}を{継|つ}ぐ: to take over family business
- {伝統|でんとう}を{継|つ}ぐ: to carry on tradition
- {後|あと}を{継|つ}ぐ: to succeed someone

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive with {次|つ}ぐ; transitive with {継|つ}ぐ.
